negative_findings.description: cbcg.me serves the same content under many differing first path segments (/me/, /r/, /c/, /e/, /en/, /eng/, /images/, /uploads/, /legal/, /discover/, /index/ and even /kursna_lista_arhiva.php/...). Search engines index these variants interchangeably.
negative_findings.result_summary: The same page (e.g. registar banaka, tarife banaka) was returned under at least three different prefixes across searches. A fetch of https://www.cbcg.me/r/mapa-sajta returned HTTP 404 although the sitemap page is indexed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hardcoded deep URLs will rot and produce false 'dead source' verdicts. Collection must resolve links dynamically from section roots, and the verifier should treat a single 404 on a prefixed URL as a prefix problem, not a dead source.

negative_findings.description: No open-data API, SDMX endpoint, or bulk-download facility for CBCG banking/payments data was found in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: All observed outputs are HTML pages plus PDF/ZIP/XLS attachments; no /api, data portal, or SDMX reference surfaced in searches.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be crawl-and-parse (PDF/XLS extraction), which is slower and more brittle; budget for document parsing rather than API ingestion.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Montenegrin for a CBCG-hosted central repository of bank Pillar 3 disclosures ('objelodanjivanje podataka kreditnih institucija').
negative_findings.result_summary: Found the regulatory basis (Odluka o adekvatnosti kapitala banke; a decision on public disclosure of credit-institution data) but no single CBCG page aggregating banks' Pillar 3 disclosure documents. The obligation appears to sit with each bank's own website.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 capital/risk disclosures likely have to be collected bank-by-bank from institution websites (a different coverage cell), not from CBCG. This is a real structural gap, not a search failure.

negative_findings.description: The fetched 'Finansijski izvještaji banaka' page rendered only a subset of institutions (six banks) although the register lists ~12 active banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetch returned CKB, Hipotekarna, Podgorička, Invest banka Montenegro (in liquidation), Prva banka, Erste. NLB, Addiko, Universal Capital, Lovćen, Zapad, Ziraat, Adriatic were not visible in the fetched rendering.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Likely pagination/JS rendering rather than missing filings — but a naive single-fetch crawler would silently under-collect. Collection must paginate or render JS and reconcile against the bank register.

negative_findings.description: The payment-services/e-money statistics sub-page URL was inferred from navigation labels observed on the parent statistics page, not directly fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Path '/podaci-o-platnim-uslugama-i-elektronskom-novcu' appeared as a navigation sibling; exact absolute URL not confirmed.

negative_findings.description: Ziraat Bank Montenegro's Serbian homepage (ziraatbank.me/sr) as fetched exposes only 'obavještenja' (notices, tariffs, general terms) and no navigation link to a financial-reports or objelodanjivanje section; the annual-reports page was only reachable via a site-scoped search engine query.

negative_findings.description: https://www.ckb.me/about-us/welcome-to-ckb/reports failed with a TLS error ('unable to verify the first certificate'), and https://www.hipotekarnabanka.com/izvjestaji/javno-objelodanjivanje-podataka returned HTTP 404 while the parent https://www.hipotekarnabanka.com/izvjestaji/ fetched cleanly and lists the disclosure documents.

negative_findings.description: Searches using the Basel term 'Stub 3' / 'Pillar 3' in Serbian returned no Montenegrin bank hits.
negative_findings.result_summary: Montenegrin banks label prudential disclosures 'javno objelodanjivanje podataka' or 'javno objavljivanje podataka' (Art. 237, Zakon o kreditnim institucijama), not Pillar 3/Stub 3.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query sets built on Basel vocabulary will systematically miss ME prudential disclosures; the two spelling variants (objelodanjivanje vs objavljivanje) must both be used.

negative_findings.description: A combined multi-bank query for 2025 disclosures (Universal Capital, Adriatic, Lovćen, Ziraat) returned only generic Montenegrin open-data and freedom-of-information results.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegrin bank in this cell was observed to operate an 'Investor Relations' section in the Western sense (IR calendar, earnings call, analyst deck, IR contact).

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Searching 'investor relations' in English will under-recover this market; navigate by 'izvještaji', 'o nama', 'odnosi sa javnošću' instead. No earnings-call transcripts should be expected as a source type.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of the CRPS public search portal (http://www.pretraga.crps.me/) failed with an OpenSSL TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR when the request was upgraded to HTTPS.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not retrieve the page body; the field structure of the public search form and result pages remains undocumented in this slice. The domain appears repeatedly in current search results, so the hypothesis is a legacy/misconfigured TLS stack or bot defence, not a dead site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated collector against CRPS will need a tolerant TLS client (or plain HTTP) and should not be designed assuming a modern HTTPS endpoint.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Montenegrin for a public, free search interface over FILED annual financial statements held by the tax authority (terms: 'pretraga finansijskih iskaza', 'javna objava finansijskih iskaza', 'pregled finansijskih iskaza').

Commercial redistributors (bilansi.me, boniteti.me, companywall.me) fill this gap, which is itself indirect evidence that no free public search exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity-level ME financial statements likely require paid vendors or FOI requests; a scraping-first collection design would fail.

negative_findings.description: None of the core supranational assessors in this cell (IMF, World Bank, EBRD, EIB, MONEYVAL) appear to publish their Montenegro financial-sector assessments in Montenegrin/Serbian. negative_findings.description: The only Montenegro FSAP material located dates to the joint IMF/World Bank FSAP mission of September 2015 (technical notes published around January 2016). No evidence of a newer FSAP or FSAP Update for Montenegro was found in the searches performed.

negative_findings.description: A dedicated MONEYVAL Montenegro country landing page URL was not isolated in these searches; individual reports were reached via the general evaluations page, plenary-outcome news items, and direct rm.coe.int document links whose slugs are opaque.

negative_findings.description: Searches repeatedly surfaced the Central Bank of Montenegro annual report (cbcg.me) and gov.me ERP pages as the national counterparties of these supranational assessments; they are national actors and therefore belong to other coverage cells, not this one.

negative_findings.description: Vijesti (vijesti.me), the largest independent Montenegrin daily and explicitly named in this coverage cell, did not surface a single article in any of seven searches, including two site-scoped local-language queries using its own domain and bank names.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the homepage URL could be established. No economy-section path, article URL pattern, or feed was confirmed. Competing dailies (Dan) and portals (CdM, RTCG) surfaced normally on identical query shapes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If Vijesti is systematically absent from the search index available to this run, keyword-based discovery will silently under-represent the outlet most likely to break bank-fee and supervision stories. Collection must be built by direct site crawl, not search.

negative_findings.description: Targeted queries for 'Portal Analitika' (portalanalitika.me) and 'Standard' (standard.co.me) as Montenegrin economy/banking outlets returned no direct hits.

negative_findings.description: Local-language searches on payment-fee increases and card pricing ('naknade banaka Crna Gora poskupljenje platne kartice') returned mostly regulator and bank-own material (CBCG fee-comparability pages, CKB general terms PDF, Prva banka card page) rather than press coverage.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment-fee changes are a core topic for this cell but Montenegrin media appear to cover them episodically, not systematically. Press monitoring alone will miss most fee events; it must be paired with the CBCG fee-comparability register and bank tariff pages, which sit outside this cell.

negative_findings.description: Ekonomist.me, described in reference material as a Podgorica-based finance/fintech magazine founded in 2014, could not be confirmed at a specific live URL in this run.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is potentially the only dedicated fintech/payments outlet in the market — the single most on-topic source for the payments half of the brief — so confirming or replacing it should be a priority in the verification pass.

negative_findings.description: No paywall, robots.txt, or terms-of-use check was performed on any candidate; access_status values are inferences from search snippets only.
negative_findings.result_summary: MINA's full wire service, eKapija premium items, and Bloomberg Adria are the three most likely to be gated, but none was tested. No fetch was attempted against any candidate in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection-method recommendations assume open access. If MINA or eKapija are licence-gated, the effective early-signal channel narrows to Bankar.me, Investitor.me and RTCG, changing the collection design.

negative_findings.description: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (Association of Banks of Montenegro) — no official website URL was surfaced by search. Only third-party references were found: an NGO registry entry (nvoinfo.me) and media mentions of its officers (Mladen Rabrenović as president, Bratislav Pejaković as secretary general) and of a 'traditional banking conference'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association is confirmed to exist and to co-organise the CBCG FinTech Hackathon, but its own conference agenda/sponsor pages could not be located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is the most likely publisher of ME-specific banking conference agendas and sponsor lists — the core artefact of this cell. Missing it leaves a hole in domestic event coverage.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public careers/vacancy pages were surfaced for NLB Banka Podgorica, Hipotekarna banka, Erste Bank Montenegro or Lovćen banka. Searches returned Wikipedia entries, bank-profile aggregators and (for Hipotekarna) only a LinkedIn company page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Career-page coverage of ME banks is currently confirmed only for CKB and Prva banka.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring signals from the second- and third-largest banks are missing, and LinkedIn — the apparent fallback channel — is ToS-restricted for automated collection.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegro-specific 'best digital bank' award programme was found. All award signals located are international programmes (Global Finance, Euromoney, The Banker) with a Montenegro country category, reported through ME media.
negative_findings.result_summary: Domestic digital-banking award ecosystem appears absent or not web-visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means award-based weak signals must be sourced from international award bodies plus local press, not from a national awards body.

negative_findings.description: CBCG FinTech Hackathon editions confirmed for 2021 and 2022 only; no evidence surfaced of editions after 2022 in this pass. A UDG announcement page carries an odd '2028' slug that was not verified.
negative_findings.result_summary: The hackathon may be dormant; treat the channel as possibly historical until a recent edition is confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects whether this is a live monitoring feed or an archival source.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn (company pages, job posts, INFINTECH showcase) is the richest single weak-signal channel for this cell but is partially login-walled and its terms of service prohibit automated scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collectable only via analyst review or a licensed data arrangement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline design that assumes scraped LinkedIn hiring data is legally and operationally unsound.

negative_findings.description: Search snapshots of ZZZCG indicated zero currently listed vacancies, and ZZZCG has published notices about changes to how vacancies are advertised.
negative_findings.result_summary: The public vacancy feed may be thin, paginated behind a form, or partly migrated; volume must be validated before relying on it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Could produce false 'no hiring activity' conclusions if the feed is simply not fully exposed.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Montenegrin and English for a dedicated financial ombudsman / alternative dispute resolution body for banking and payments in Montenegro (terms: finansijski ombudsman, ombudsman za bankarske usluge, vansudsko rješavanje sporova korisnika finansijskih usluga).
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated financial ombudsman was found. The general human-rights Ombudsman (Zaštitnik ljudskih prava i sloboda) has no banking-specific mandate and explicitly no jurisdiction over courts; complaint escalation instead runs bank internal complaint body -> CBCG Service for the Protection of Users of Financial Services.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out a source class that exists in neighbouring markets and concentrates complaint-channel collection on CBCG plus the consumer NGO CEZAP; also means no published individual complaint decisions naming banks.

negative_findings.description: Searched (sr and en) for an interchange-fee or card-scheme dispute, court case or competition proceeding in Montenegro (interchange naknada spor, međubankarska naknada, Visa, Mastercard, sudski postupak).
negative_findings.result_summary: No dispute, AZZK case or judgment on interchange was located. Only the statutory framework surfaced — a Law on interbank fees and special rules for payment card operations reported as Official Gazette of Montenegro no. 145/21 — plus bank card tariff PDFs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The adversarial payments-economics detail this cell is meant to harvest appears not to exist yet in Montenegro; card economics must instead be reconstructed from the statute, bank tariff sheets and CBCG fee-comparability disclosures.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to find a standalone published CBCG annual report on consumer/user protection with complaint counts by bank.
negative_findings.result_summary: CBCG pages state that data on complaints, their merit and measures taken are compiled and that a bylaw sets reporting deadlines, and the CBCG Annual Report contains a consumer-protection chapter, but no separate per-bank complaint statistics report URL was found in this pass. Unverified whether such a standalone publication exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per-institution complaint counts are the highest-value item in this cell; if unpublished, an access-to-information request (slobodan pristup informacijama) may be the only route.

negative_findings.description: Searched for AZZK decisions specifically concerning Montenegrin banks or payment institutions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-related material found on azzk.me is largely cross-border (e.g. an older Societe Generale Banka Srbije / KBC Banka Beograd concentration PDF) and 2024 lists reportedly include NLB/Addiko and Alta Pay Group/Addiko items, but no domestic Montenegrin bank merger decision text was directly opened and confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The volume of genuinely Montenegro-specific banking merger decisions may be small; expectations for this channel should be calibrated before building heavy collection.

negative_findings.description: Court decision databases on sudovi.me were identified but their search/filter capabilities and full-text coverage for competition and banking matters were not exercised in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Listing URLs exist (/uscg/odluke/, /sdvi/odluke, /pscg) but it is unverified whether decisions are full-text searchable, anonymised, or only partially published.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines whether court/enforcement notices can be systematically collected or only sampled.

negative_findings.description: The canonical hostname of Montenegro's open data portal could not be confirmed. Searches surfaced gov.me articles announcing a new 'Open Data Portal' but returned Croatia's data.gov.hr rather than a working data.gov.me; no ME portal landing URL was directly observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: gov.me announcement pages found; portal hostname unverified (data.gov.me is a hypothesis, not a finding).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Open-data portal is the main machine-readable alternative to rotating institutional PDFs; without the right host, dataset harvesting cannot be automated.

negative_findings.description: No domestic or sr-language credit-rating agency covering Montenegrin banks was found. Searches on 'agencija za rejting Crna Gora banka ocjena izvještaj' returned no national CRA; ME coverage appears to come solely from international agencies publishing in English.
negative_findings.result_summary: No ME-domiciled or sr-language CRA identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: All rating-based verification for ME banks depends on paywalled English-language international agencies, raising cost and access risk.

negative_findings.description: No public S&P/Moody's/Fitch rating was found for individual Montenegrin banks (CKB, Hipotekarna banka, NLB Banka Podgorica, Erste Bank Podgorica). Coverage found was sovereign-level plus parent-group level.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-level ME ratings not evidenced in open sources this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level credit opinions may simply not exist for ME subsidiaries; collection design should rely on parent-group reports and CBCG supervisory data instead.

negative_findings.description: Montenegroberza's issuer-disclosure archive structure was not directly observed; the exchange URL was inferred from third-party references (SeeCapitalMarkets) rather than fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Exchange as a disclosure archive is a strong hypothesis, unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the exchange keeps a durable filings archive it is the single best non-web-archive fallback for listed ME banks.

negative_findings.description: The widely cited domain 'montenegroberza.com' is NOT the Montenegro Stock Exchange. Fetching https://www.montenegroberza.com/ returned an unrelated commercial investing-content site with sections 'Frontier Markets', 'RWA & Tokenization', 'Equities & ETFs', 'Offshore Access' and a guest-post/contributor solicitation — a classic expired-domain repurposing. Wikipedia and several aggregators still list it as the official site.
negative_findings.result_summary: The real exchange domain is mnse.me (confirmed independently via company-registry and chamber-of-commerce contact records showing info@mnse.me and @mnse.me staff addresses, and by fetching https://www.mnse.me/ which served live Montenegroberza trading data dated 25/08/2026).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector seeded from Wikipedia or a stale link list would silently ingest SEO content as if it were exchange disclosure. This must be hard-blocklisted in the source registry.

negative_findings.description: The Montenegroberza site (mnse.me) has a flat, minimal navigation — Dobrodošli / Simboli / Vijesti / Kontakt. There is no separate 'Obavještenja emitenata' or 'Izvještaji emitenata' section distinct from the general Vijesti feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Issuer material-event notices, listing-committee decisions and exchange notices are all mixed into a single /code/navigate.asp?Id=122 stream, and per-issuer disclosure history must be reconstructed by filtering that stream on issuer name/symbol.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design cannot rely on a per-issuer disclosure index; it needs entity resolution over free-text Montenegrin announcement titles, which raises extraction cost and recall risk for bank-specific events.

negative_findings.description: CRPI (Centralni registar propisanih informacija, crpi.me), referenced from the KTK site as the central storage mechanism for regulated information, rendered only a bare 'CRPI Portal' header with no navigable content or search. The www.crpi.me host additionally presented a TLS certificate whose SANs cover only scmnreporting.me hostnames (iam./portal./sp./www.), and https://www.scmnreporting.me/ returned HTTP 404 at the root.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public, searchable central repository of Montenegrin listed-issuer regulated information could be reached in this pass. Status is UNVERIFIED — hosts are live and certificates valid, so this reads as an auth gate or wrong entry path, not a dead service.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This would be the single highest-value source in the cell if accessible: one canonical feed of periodic reports, inside information and major-holdings notifications for all listed banks. Its absence forces reconstruction from the exchange feed plus individual bank websites, which is lossier and slower.

negative_findings.description: CKDD (the CSD) publishes issuer, trading-symbol and debt-securities registers, but its shareholder services page states that shareholder lists are prepared on request of a security owner or a group of owners entitled to inspect the list, against a price list. No public shareholder/ownership search interface was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Detailed shareholder structure for Montenegrin listed banks is request-gated and likely fee-bearing, not open data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Shareholder structure is one of the three explicit targets of this coverage cell. Ownership-change tracking must therefore be built indirectly — from exchange block-trade and material-event notices, KTK prospectus documents, bank annual reports and trade press — with a known recall gap.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed, JSON API, or bulk-download endpoint was observed on either mnse.me or scmn.me for issuer announcements. mnse.me is a legacy classic-ASP application using query-string navigation (navigate.asp?Id=NNN&newsId=NNN / &stockId=NNN); scmn.me publishes registers only as dated-filename .xls files and documents as PDFs under /images/.
negative_findings.result_summary: All collection in this cell must be HTML/PDF/XLS scraping with custom change detection; no vendor-grade feed exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic engineering expectations and argues for filename/ID-diffing strategies plus document hashing to avoid duplicate ingestion across mirror domains (e.g. hipotekarnabanka.com vs hb.co.me vs ftp.hb.co.me).

negative_findings.description: The mnse.me homepage displayed a MONEX index value dated 31 December 2010 alongside live 25 August 2026 trading prices and market capitalisation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Parts of the exchange site carry stale or mis-labelled reference values.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Freshness validation and per-field date extraction are mandatory when ingesting mnse.me; naive scraping would mix a 2010 index level into a 2026 time series.

negative_findings.description: Attempting the detail-page pattern https://www.mnse.me/code/navigate.asp?Id=122&newsId=1 returned 'Podaci ne postoje' (data does not exist).
negative_findings.result_summary: News IDs are not densely enumerable from 1; historical back-fill by brute-force ID walking is unreliable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Archive back-fill for issuer announcements must harvest IDs from paginated list pages (or a web-archive crawl) rather than enumerating the ID space.

negative_findings.description: The exchange offers an EN toggle (/code/navigate.asp?Id=125, index.asp?jezik=en) but the underlying announcement content observed remained in Montenegrin/Serbian. KTK maintains parallel /en/ paths, though issuer documents (prospectuses, registers) are Montenegrin-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-language search alone would have surfaced almost none of the operative disclosure surface for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that local-language collection and NLP (Montenegrin/Serbian, both Latin and Cyrillic-tolerant) is mandatory for this cell rather than optional.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Serbian/Montenegrin for a domestically licensed card processor or standalone acquirer ('kartično poslovanje', 'procesiranje kartica', 'Multicard', 'Digital Systems') and found no Montenegro-domiciled dedicated card-processing company with its own disclosure surface.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card processing in ME appears to be delivered by banks (notably CKB/OTP, Hipotekarna) and by regional vendors (Payten/Asseco SEE, Monri) rather than by a locally licensed standalone processor. Searches returned only unrelated hardware retailers for 'procesori'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's 'card processors and acquirers' half must be tracked indirectly through bank acquiring pages and regional vendor announcements; expecting local processor disclosures would leave a permanent blind spot.

negative_findings.description: The CBCG e-money institution register page states that no e-money institution is currently entered.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'U Registru trenutno nema upisane institucije za elektronski novac' observed on the register page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is currently no ME-licensed EMI population to monitor; e-money activity, if any, arrives via banks or EU-passported entities. The register should be treated as a tripwire rather than a data feed.

negative_findings.description: Searched for press releases / 'saopštenja' from the licensed ME payment institutions (Payspot ME, Alta Pay Group, Moneta MNE, Prestopay, Capital Transfer MNE, Business Integration and Business Intelligence).
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated press-release or investor-relations sections were located for these entities; several (Prestopay, Business Integration and Business Intelligence, Moneta MNE) returned no identifiable corporate website at all. Capital Transfer MNE's only visible channel is social media.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Corporate-disclosure coverage for ME payment institutions cannot rely on IR pages; it must lean on the CBCG register PDFs, CRPS filings and local news pickup.

negative_findings.description: A fetch of the tariff-overview parent path returned HTTP 404 while its child path /tarife-banaka appears in search results and in-site navigation.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.cbcg.me/me/kljucne-funkcije/platni-promet/pregledi-tarifa-pruzalaca-platnih-usluga returned 404 on a single attempt; the section is very likely live under language-prefixed or child paths (me/, eng/, r/, legal/ variants observed).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recorded as unverified rather than dead, per the rule that one failed fetch is a hypothesis. The verification pass should probe the language-prefix variants before marking anything broken.

negative_findings.description: Searched for annual reports / earnings disclosures by ME payment institutions and e-money issuers.
negative_findings.result_summary: None of the seven registered payment institutions is listed on the Montenegro Stock Exchange or publishes annual reports publicly; financial statements are reachable only via CRPS/Tax Administration filings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The run topics 'annual reports', 'investor relations' and 'earnings' have essentially no direct surface in this cell; CRPS becomes the mandatory substitute and should be prioritised in collection design.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Montenegro-specific Visa or Mastercard newsroom/press-release site was found. Visa serves ME via the regional visasoutheasteurope.com country subtree and Mastercard via the Serbian-language mastercard.rs 'Crna Gora' pages and global newsroom filters.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in both sr and en returned scheme marketing/product pages, FAQs and a Facebook page (MastercardCG), not a country press office feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Scheme country announcements for ME must be harvested from regional/global newsrooms with keyword filters rather than a country feed; expect low recall and latency for ME-specific items.

negative_findings.description: No national card switch / domestic card scheme or shared card-processing house for Montenegro was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language search for 'procesor kartica / obrada kartičnih transakcija Crna Gora' returned only consumer-electronics retailers and unrelated pages; no evidence of a domestic card scheme analogous to DinaCard.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests ME card processing is handled by international schemes and bank/third-party processors abroad, so the card-infrastructure signal must be tracked via issuers, schemes and CBCG statistics rather than a national switch operator.

negative_findings.description: Reported instant-payment transaction caps differ across sources (EUR 1,000 per transaction in law-amendment coverage vs EUR 3,000 per transaction in go-live coverage).
negative_findings.result_summary: Draft-law reporting cited a 1,000 EUR cap and 10-second execution; go-live reporting cited a 3,000 EUR cap and 5-cent fee ceiling for transfers up to 200 EUR.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Parameter values must be sourced from the CBCG instant-payment rulebook/decision, not from press; secondary-source figures should be treated as unverified until matched against the CBCG page.

negative_findings.description: No page in this slice was fetched directly; all candidates come from search-result evidence, so liveness, robots.txt posture and bot defences are unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned consistent, plausible URLs across cbcg.me, europeanpaymentscouncil.eu, bancaditalia.it, worldbank.org, visasoutheasteurope.com, mastercard.rs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Corporate scheme sites (Visa/Mastercard) commonly sit behind Akamai/CDN bot protection; the deterministic verification pass should treat 403s there as bot-defended-but-live rather than dead.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of an active Montenegrin startup-specific press-release wire or a national fintech-association newsroom that aggregates non-bank payment announcements. ICT Cortex is the closest substitute but is an ICT cluster, not a payments body.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sr and en surfaced only general tech portals (Digitalizuj.Me, itspot.me) and the ICT Cortex blog; no dedicated fintech PR channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must rely on per-company crawling plus media relays, which raises miss-risk for very small launches.

negative_findings.description: Searched for regional challenger wallets (Aircash, KEKS Pay, Revolut, Monesa) entering or announcing Montenegro; results returned Croatian-market coverage only.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Montenegro-specific launch, licensing or press announcement for these wallets was found in this run — absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Regional-challenger entry would be a major disruption vector for merchant acceptance; the gap should be closed by checking the CBCG e-money/payment-institution registers and each wallet's own newsroom directly.

negative_findings.description: Local-language coverage for merchant-side software was thin on some concepts: no established Montenegrin term surfaced for 'softPOS'/'tap-to-phone', and searches on 'QR plaćanje' returned mostly Serbian (RS) fiscal-receipt content rather than Montenegrin merchant QR schemes.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr queries on QR/merchant acceptance leaked heavily into the Serbian market; no ME-specific merchant QR scheme identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query glossary needs ME-specific disambiguators ('Crna Gora', '.me', 'CBCG', 'Podgorica') and English-in-local terms ('softPOS', 'tap to phone') to avoid RS/HR contamination.

negative_findings.description: The only funding-data aggregator found for ME fintech (Tracxn) lists ~102 entities dominated by forex/CFD and crypto shells domiciled in Montenegro (AMarkets, GANNMarkets, GoDefi, Impact, Prosecure) rather than domestic payment challengers.
negative_findings.result_summary: High entity count, low relevance density; only ~10 reported as funded.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naive use of the aggregator would badly distort the ME fintech actor map; every entry needs cross-validation against CBCG registers.

negative_findings.description: Several company homepages were inferred from organisation names rather than confirmed by a fetch in this run: logate.com, fleka.me, tehnopolis.me, and the 2bi.me root.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs provided with moderate confidence; only prestopay.me was fetched directly this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as stable collection targets.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of https://cejn.gov.me/tenders returned no usable page content — no listing rows, no filters, no URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis: the tender listing is client-side rendered or bot-defended, not dead. The domain is repeatedly cited as the live official portal by ujn.gov.me, gov.me and multiple aggregators, so it is recorded as unverified-but-almost-certainly-live, never as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell may need a headless browser or an internal JSON/API endpoint rather than a plain HTTP fetch; the collection design must budget for that.

negative_findings.description: Targeted local-language searches for concrete Montenegrin banking/payment procurement items ('POS terminal', 'platne kartice', 'bankarske usluge', 'bankomat') returned portal home pages and Bosnian/Serbian equivalents rather than actual ME notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: No individual Montenegrin banking-services or POS/card tender document was located through open web search in this run. The closest hits were a BiH treasury banking-services tender and BiH award notices on ejn.gov.ba — different jurisdiction, not usable for ME.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Montenegrin notice text appears to be poorly indexed by general search engines (consistent with a JS-rendered portal). Item-level discovery will have to happen inside CEJN's own search, not via web search — a structural constraint on this workstream.

negative_findings.description: The procurement review commission does not live at the plausible-looking kzp.gov.me.
negative_findings.result_summary: Its decisions register is at kontrola-nabavki.me/rjesenja (admin instance at admin.kontrola-nabavki.me); contact email komisija@nabavka.gov.me. The guessed gov.me subdomain was not found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Illustrates that ME procurement institutions are scattered across gov.me, .me and .co.me domains; any seed list built by pattern-guessing gov.me subdomains will silently miss sources.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegro-specific banking or payment-services notice was retrievable from TED via general web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only TED's own explanatory pages and one EU Delegation security-services tender surfaced. Whether ME entities publish to TED at all (Montenegro is a candidate country, not an EU member) was not established in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: TED's value for this cell may be limited to EU-Delegation/IPA contracts rather than national ME procurement; the collection plan should test this before investing in TED tooling.

negative_findings.description: The World Bank project id for the Montenegro Financial Infrastructure Modernization / SEPA (TIPS clone) operation was not confirmed against a project page.
negative_findings.result_summary: A 2025 disclosure PDF filename contains 'P509405', which is suggestive but not verified as this project's id. Recorded as a hypothesis, not a fact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The project id is the join key to the procurement plan and award data on Finances One; getting it wrong would silently pull the wrong pipeline.

negative_findings.description: No public vendor case study, reference page or go-live press release was found naming the core-banking platform of any Montenegrin bank (CKB, Hipotekarna, NLB Podgorica, Erste ME, Addiko ME, Lovćen, Prva banka, Universal Capital, Adriatic, Ziraat ME).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches across generic core-banking vendor queries, bank-specific queries and named-vendor queries (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Backbase, Diebold Nixdorf, NCR) returned zero ME core-banking references. Only ancillary systems (security, SoftPOS, e-banking, CRM, HR, data centre) surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The core-banking layer is the highest-value procurement signal and it is invisible on the vendor side for ME. Coverage of this workstream must therefore lean on group-level parent disclosures (OTP, NLB, Erste, Addiko) and on bank T&C/app metadata fingerprints rather than vendor marketing.

negative_findings.description: No AML / financial-crime-compliance vendor was found publicly naming a Montenegrin bank as a customer.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-language searches on AML vendor + Montenegro returned only generic vendor-ranking listicles; no case study, press release or reference page named an ME institution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: AML tooling is a mandated spend driven by MONEYVAL/EU-accession pressure, so the absence of vendor-side traces means this segment must be tracked via regulator (CBCG, Uprava za sprječavanje pranja novca) publications and bank annual reports instead of supplier marketing.

negative_findings.description: Local-language (sr/cnr) queries for AML vendor references were not productive because no ME-specific local vocabulary for AML product procurement surfaced in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local terms attempted for other subtopics (dobavljač, referenca, implementacija, saopštenje, ugovor, rješenje) worked well for ATM/POS, e-banking and integrator queries but the AML sweep was effectively English-only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per the mandate, English-only coverage is a defect. A follow-up pass must run terms such as 'sprječavanje pranja novca', 'softver za usklađenost', 'monitoring transakcija', 'sankcione liste' against ME vendor and bank sites.

negative_findings.description: The Logate corporate URL (logate.com) was inferred from company identity rather than confirmed in a search result; the confirmed trace was a third-party profile on itkonekt.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank references for Logate (contact centre at Lovćen banka and CKB) appear in secondary Montenegrin sources, not yet confirmed on a vendor-owned page in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The vendor-owned reference page is the higher-credibility artefact and must be located and verified before the Lovćen/CKB contact-centre attribution is treated as established fact.

negative_findings.description: The available web search is US-biased and returned Wikipedia/bank-directory noise for many Montenegrin queries instead of vendor pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Several sr-language queries returned generic bank profiles (thebanks.eu, Wikipedia, nomadcapitalist) rather than vendor references, indicating index thinness for the .me domain space.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-side discovery for ME likely requires site-scoped crawling (site:printecgroup.com, site:payten.com, site:asee.* plus each .me vendor domain) rather than open-web querying; this changes the collection design for this cell.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, separately-published country-by-country reporting (CBCR) file naming Montenegro was located for any parent group in this run; CBCR appears only as an annex inside the group annual report PDF (Erste, Addiko, NLB as EU/CRD-scope institutions).
negative_findings.result_summary: Generic CRD IV CBCR explainers (KPMG, PwC trackers) surfaced instead of issuer-specific Montenegro tables.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must target the annual-report PDF annex by text search ('Montenegro', 'Crna Gora'), not a separate CBCR document endpoint.

negative_findings.description: Universal Capital Bank AD, Zapad banka AD, Prva banka Crne Gore and First Financial Bank were not tied to any listed foreign banking group with public consolidated IR reporting in the searches run.
negative_findings.result_summary: These appear locally/privately held or held by non-reporting owners; Adriatic Bank is described as linked to a US-based Adriatic Capital LLC with no traceable public IR site found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cell #9 (foreign parent group reporting) simply cannot cover these banks - they must be picked up by local-disclosure cells, and the intel gap should be stated explicitly rather than assumed away.

negative_findings.description: Local-language (sr/me) searches for group-level quarterly presentations ('kvartalna prezentacija grupe', 'maticna banka konsolidovani izvjestaj') returned almost no parent-group material - only local subsidiary reports and CBCG pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Parent groups publish group IR in EN (and HU/SL/DE/PL home languages); Montenegrin-language coverage exists only at subsidiary statutory level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: for group-segment KPIs, English (plus HU/SL/PL home-market filings) is the operative language; sr/me collection should target subsidiary statutory statements for reconciliation only.

negative_findings.description: Earnings-call transcripts naming Montenegro are largely behind paywalls (Seeking Alpha, Quartr, Investing.com partial).
negative_findings.result_summary: Free access is limited to summaries and excerpts; issuer-hosted call decks and webcasts remain free.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget for either a transcript licence or an ASR pipeline over issuer webcast audio if analyst-Q&A colour on Montenegro is required.

negative_findings.description: Some IR landing URLs were inferred from search-result domains rather than fetched in this pass (e.g. asee.io investor-relations path, ziraatbank.com.tr financials path, erstegroup financial-reports path).
negative_findings.result_summary: Document-level URLs returned by search are recorded in example_urls; landing pages are best-effort and unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass must resolve these; a 403/404 here should trigger a site-search retry, not a dead-source verdict.

negative_findings.description: The expected domain 'ubcg.me' for the Association of Montenegrin Banks does not appear to exist; the association's actual site is ubcg.info.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language queries containing "ubcg.me" returned no association-owned page; a follow-up query surfaced ubcg.info/en/legislation/ and ubcg.info article paths.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline seeded with ubcg.me would record a false dead source and lose the most important association in the cell.

negative_findings.description: The Chamber of Economy's English-language committee paths under komora.me/en/cem/... appear in search results but returned HTTP 404 on fetch, while the Montenegrin paths under komora.me/komora/odbori/... resolved correctly.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 on https://komora.me/en/cem/udruzenje-bankarstva-i-drugih-finansijskih-organizacija-i-osiguranja, /en/cem/udruzenja, /pkcg/odbori-udruzenja/ and /o-nama/publikacije/; success on https://komora.me/komora/odbori and its banking sub-page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The site has been restructured and the search index is stale; collectors must use the sr path scheme, which is also the authoritative one. Do not mark these as dead sources - the content exists under different URLs.

negative_findings.description: MFIC (Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council) blocks plain HTTP fetching.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden on both https://mfic.me/white-book/ and https://www.mfic.me/committees/committees; the same pages are indexed and referenced by third parties (CorD Magazine, Golden Group), so the site is live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The White Book is the highest-value position-paper series in this cell; a naive collector would classify it as dead. It needs a headless-browser or header-spoofing fetch path.

negative_findings.description: No published committee minutes were located for either the PKCG banking board or UBCG.
negative_findings.result_summary: The PKCG banking board page lists officers and 23 member representatives but carries no minutes, agendas or document links; UBCG publishes news items and the Bankar magazine rather than minutes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'committee minutes' element of this cell's mandate is not satisfiable directly; the practical substitutes are Glasnik session write-ups, PKCG announcements and trade-press coverage.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Montenegrin fintech or payment-services association was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searches for an IKT/fintech association returned ICT Cortex (a general tech cluster), IT klaster Crne Gore, the newly formed CFO Asocijacija, and a 2022 UNDP regulatory assessment of the fintech framework - but no fintech trade body. Fintech coordination instead happens through CBCG + ICT Cortex + UBCG joint events (FinTech hackathon, sandbox discussions).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment-industry positions in ME must be tracked through the banking association and the tech cluster jointly; there is no single fintech lobby to monitor.

negative_findings.description: Montenegro Business Alliance (MBA) has no located live official website.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only third-party organisation records (DevelopmentAid, WBC-RTI, directory listings) and dated news items were found; no mba.* or similar own domain surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MBA may be dormant or absorbed; treating it as an active association would produce a permanently empty collection target.

coverage_gaps.description: CBCG publishes payment-system volumes (RTGS/DNS/IPS) and, apparently, payment-services statistics, but no card-scheme-level, acquiring-level or POS/ATM-terminal-estate breakdown surfaced in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm the contents of 'Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu' and, if terminal/card counts are absent, cover via bank annual reports, Monstat, and card schemes in other cells; consider an FOI (pristup informacijama) request to CBCG.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell maps CBCG as publisher but not the individual banks'/PSPs' own investor-relations and disclosure pages, which are where Pillar 3 disclosures, shareholder-assembly materials and press releases actually live.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Spawn a per-institution cell seeded from the CBCG Registar banaka and the payment-institution/e-money registers (12+ banks plus PIs/EMIs), plus parent-group IR sites (OTP, NLB, Erste, Addiko, Ziraat).

coverage_gaps.description: No non-CBCG archival/mirroring source was identified for withdrawn or superseded CBCG documents; CBCG appears to overwrite or move publication pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Wayback Machine snapshots as a secondary archive for key CBCG pages, and snapshot every downloaded PDF locally with retrieval timestamps.

coverage_gaps.description: The English (/en/) mirror covers publications well but registers, tariffs and statistics appear predominantly Montenegrin-only; some /eng/ paths exist inconsistently.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat sr as the authoritative collection language for registers/tariffs/statistics and en only for flagship publications; budget for sr-language PDF parsing and translation.

coverage_gaps.description: Publication cadence and exact release dates (statistical publication calendar) were referenced but the calendar page itself was not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and track the CBCG 'kalendar objavljivanja statističkih podataka' to schedule collection precisely instead of blind polling.

coverage_gaps.description: Of the 11 licensed banks in the CBCG register, a self-published reports page was located for 10 (CKB, Hipotekarna, Erste, NLB, Addiko, Prva, Lovćen, Adriatic, Universal Capital, Zapad, Ziraat). No page-level verification was done for any bank's full year-depth, and no scouting was done for banks in liquidation/wind-down or for branches of foreign banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-bank deep-link pass (one bank per query, Serbian terms + site: scoping) and record the canonical reports URL, earliest available year, and PDF path pattern for each of the 11 registered banks; re-run against the register monthly to catch licence changes.

coverage_gaps.description: General assembly / skupština akcionara materials (agendas, decisions, dividend and capital resolutions) were only confirmed for Hipotekarna banka. Other banks' assembly notices were not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search per bank for 'poziv za sjednicu Skupštine akcionara', 'odluke Skupštine akcionara', 'obavještenje akcionarima', and cross-check the Montenegro securities market issuer pages (scmn.me) which may carry filings the banks omit.

coverage_gaps.description: Almost all primary documents are Serbian/Montenegrin only; English versions are sporadic (Erste: one 2015 report; NLB and UCB and Adriatic have partial EN locales). Some Erste documents were described as Cyrillic script while most Montenegrin material is Latin.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for sr-Latn plus occasional sr-Cyrl OCR/normalisation in the parsing layer; do not rely on EN mirrors for time-series continuity, and store the local-language document as the canonical artefact.

coverage_gaps.description: Year-depth per bank site is uneven and only partly observed (Hipotekarna 2007+, Erste 2009+, Addiko 2011+, Ziraat 2015+, NLB visibly only 2022+ before 'Show more' expansion). JS accordions may hide older years from a plain HTTP crawl.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use a JS-capable fetcher for NLB-style accordions, and backfill missing years from the CBCG per-bank archive whose PDF paths are enumerable by year and bank code.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-issued press-release / news channels were confirmed only for Universal Capital and Hipotekarna in this pass, although the topic scope includes press releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each of the 11 banks locate the 'Novosti'/'Vijesti'/'Obavještenja'/'Mediji i publikacije' section and register it as a separate source with a monthly cadence, distinct from the statutory-report source.

coverage_gaps.description: robots.txt, ToS and rate-limit posture were not inspected for any bank domain in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before enabling automated collection, fetch robots.txt for ckb.me, hipotekarnabanka.com, erstebank.me, nlb.me, addiko.me, prvabankacg.com, lovcenbanka.me, adriaticbank.com, ucbank.me, zapadbanka.me, ziraatbank.me, cbcg.me and record crawl-delay/disallow rules; treat thebanks.eu as ToS-restricted until checked.

coverage_gaps.description: The single most important source in this cell (CRPS public search) could not be retrieved in-session due to a TLS error.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-attempt with a permissive TLS client and plain HTTP, and via a browser session; document the search form parameters and result-page schema.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed lawful, scalable channel for obtaining filed annual accounts of unlisted ME banks, payment institutions and vendor subsidiaries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Trial bilansi.me and boniteti.me with a 10-entity watchlist; in parallel test a FOI request (zahtjev za slobodan pristup informacijama) to Uprava prihoda i carina for filed statements of named entities, to establish whether filings are public documents.

coverage_gaps.description: A new Zakon o računovodstvu (Sl. list CG 84/2025, in force 8 Aug 2025) postdates most of the filing-procedure material found, which is largely 2020-2021 vintage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Read the 2025 law and any new Pravilnik to confirm current deadlines, forms, audit thresholds and — critically — whether it introduces public disclosure of financial statements.

coverage_gaps.description: data.gov.me was identified but its actual catalogue was not enumerated for registry/tax/statistics datasets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the data.gov.me catalogue (and its data.europa.eu mirror) filtered by publisher and by keywords 'privredni subjekti', 'finansijski iskazi', 'poreski obveznici'.

coverage_gaps.description: Other statutory registers likely relevant to payments actors were not explored in this slice: registar zaloga (pledges), registar neprofitnih organizacija, the Ministry of Finance auditor register, and the Central Depository Agency (CDA) shareholder register for joint-stock banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell with searches for 'registar zaloga Crna Gora', 'Centralna depozitarna agencija akcionari banke', 'registar ovlašćenih revizora Ministarstvo finansija'.

coverage_gaps.description: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB), the Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF), EU4Business/EFSE and the Regional Cooperation Council were not searched in this pass, although they fund and assess Montenegrin financial intermediaries and SME lending.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over wbif.eu, coebank.org, efse.lu and rcc.int filtered on Montenegro financial-sector operations and assessments.

coverage_gaps.description: No payments-specific supranational assessor was located for Montenegro beyond the 2015 World Bank FSAP technical note — e.g. CPMI/BIS red-book style coverage, or SEPA/EPC-side accession documentation assessing Montenegrin scheme compliance.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the European Payments Council SEPA participation documentation and BIS/CPMI country coverage for Montenegro; also check ECB convergence/Western Balkans workshop outputs.

coverage_gaps.description: Candidates in this cell are overwhelmingly PDF/HTML narrative. Machine-readable series (IMF FSI database, World Bank Global Financial Development / Findex, EBRD Banking Environment and Performance) were not explicitly enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up pass to register the IMF FSI, IMF data API, World Bank indicator API and Global Findex Montenegro slices as structured-data sources with API-based collection.

coverage_gaps.description: No sr-language primary document from any supranational assessor was found; local-language coverage of this cell rests on media and EU-info relays only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Track sr-language government translations of EC recommendations (Ministry of European Affairs / Programme of Accession) as the local-language proxy layer for this cell, coordinating with the national-actor cell to avoid duplication.

coverage_gaps.description: Several large PDFs (EC enlargement document-download endpoints, EBRD dam/ asset paths, IMF media source-pdf paths) use rotating or CDN-style URLs that may change between publication cycles; none were fetch-tested in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic verification pass resolve each PDF link and, where fragile, store a landing-page URL plus a title-based re-discovery query rather than the raw asset path.

coverage_gaps.description: No Albanian-language Montenegrin media were searched or found, despite a significant Albanian-speaking population in Ulcinj/Malesija and MINA operating an Albanian service.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass with Albanian banking terms ('bankat në Mal të Zi', 'fitimi i bankave', 'tarifat bankare') against Montenegrin Albanian-language outlets and MINA's Albanian feed.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell found general and business press but no broadcast/video-first or podcast sources beyond RTCG's text site, and no social/professional channels (LinkedIn newsrooms, X accounts of bank PR desks and financial journalists) where appointments and deals often break first.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a pass over Montenegrin financial journalists' and bank communications teams' social accounts, plus RTCG/TV Vijesti/Prva TV business programme archives, to catch appointment and deal signals ahead of article publication.

coverage_gaps.description: Only RTCG and Monitor were found to offer deep, systematically addressable archives (numeric article ids; PDF back-issues). For most portals the historical depth and archive URL structure are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each retained portal, probe archive/pagination structure and sitemap.xml, and register Wayback Machine coverage as a fallback so a multi-year fee-and-earnings timeline can be reconstructed.

coverage_gaps.description: Press coverage found is heavily weighted to sector-level profit aggregates derived from CBCG data. Individual-bank annual reports, investor-relations material and AGM/shareholder items were barely represented in media coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat this cell as an event and interpretation layer only; pair it with cells covering CBCG publications, the Montenegroberza listing disclosures and each bank's own newsroom for primary IR documents.

coverage_gaps.description: Substantial republication overlap was observed across CdM, Aktuelno, Kodex and Borba, much of it likely originating from the MINA wire, but the originating outlet could not be determined from search snippets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build near-duplicate detection and first-seen timestamping across these portals so that credibility and latency scores attach to the originating source rather than the fastest republisher.

coverage_gaps.description: Career/vacancy channels are unmapped for NLB Banka Podgorica, Hipotekarna banka, Erste Bank Montenegro, Lovćen banka, Universal Capital Bank, Adriatic Bank, Ziraat Bank Montenegro and the Central Bank's own recruitment page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the CBCG list of licensed banks (https://www.cbcg.me/me/javnost-rada/informacije/korisni-linkovi/banke-u-crnoj-gori) and, for each, probe /karijera, /kariera, /posao, /o-nama/karijera and /en/careers paths directly rather than via search engines.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payment actors are entirely unmapped in this cell: licensed payment institutions and e-money issuers, card processors, ATM/POS acquirers/deployers and PSPs operating in ME. Their hiring and conference presence is arguably a sharper signal than bank hiring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the CBCG register of payment institutions and e-money institutions, then run the same job-posting/conference/award sweep against each registered entity name in sr and en.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference sponsor and exhibitor rosters were identified at the site level but no individual sponsor list was actually retrieved for any ME event (INFINTECH sponsor page, IT SPOT sponsor tiers, MFM partners). Only Technobank's general sponsor (Payten) was observed via media coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Direct-fetch the sponsor/partner/exhibitor subpages per edition and archive them; use web.archive.org for prior editions to build a multi-year vendor-presence series.

coverage_gaps.description: Wider-Balkans events beyond Technobank and Balkan Payment Forum were not swept — e.g. Serbian, Croatian, Bosnian, Albanian and North Macedonian banking-technology conferences and national digital-banking awards where ME banks or their group parents (OTP, NLB, Erste) appear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-country pass in each local language (bs/hr/mk/sq/sl) for 'konferencija bankarske tehnologije', 'sponzori', 'izlagači', 'nagrada digitalna banka'.

coverage_gaps.description: No compliant substitute for LinkedIn hiring data has been identified (e.g. licensed job-posting datasets, Google Jobs structured data, or bank ATS endpoints exposing JSON).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each ME bank for a hosted ATS (TalentLyft, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Teamtailor) whose public board offers a structured feed; that is the legal, machine-readable path to the same signal.

coverage_gaps.description: The local-language glossary for this cell is built but untested against boolean job-board search: terms used include oglas za posao, slobodna radna mjesta, karijera, otvorene pozicije, platni promet, kartično poslovanje, digitalno bankarstvo, hakaton, takmičenje, nagrada, priznanje, sponzori, izlagači, konferencija, klaster. Not yet exercised: 'sistem osnovnog bankarstva'/'core banking' English-in-local usage, 'instant plaćanja', 'mobilno bankarstvo', 'PSD2 usklađenost', 'procesiranje kartica', 'bankomat/POS terminali'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run job-board and conference queries with the untested terms, including Latin/Cyrillic variants and the common English-in-Serbian job titles ('core banking developer', 'payments engineer').

coverage_gaps.description: AZZK decision archive structure was inferred from year-index URLs and search snippets; the full year coverage (how far back listings go, whether pre-2013 decisions are archived) is unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate azzk.me/rjesenja-YYYY-godina-koncentracije/ for 2013-2026 and the /docs/ legacy path, and record which years actually resolve.

coverage_gaps.description: No per-institution complaint statistics identified anywhere in the public domain for Montenegrin banks and payment institutions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: File a freedom-of-information request (Zakon o slobodnom pristupu informacijama) with CBCG for complaint counts by institution and by complaint category, and check the CBCG Annual Report consumer-protection chapter for the aggregate series first.

coverage_gaps.description: Enforcement-agent (javni izvršitelji) and their chamber, plus notary/enforcement notices, were not searched; these carry bank foreclosure and debt-enforcement volumes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Komora javnih izvršitelja Crne Gore', 'javni izvršitelj oglas prodaja nepokretnosti banka' and map the notice-publication channel.

coverage_gaps.description: Official Gazette (Službeni list Crne Gore, sluzbenilist.me) was not directly searched, although it is the authoritative publication venue for the interchange law and for some agency acts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map sluzbenilist.me search/archive access and locate issue 145/2021 and any amendments to the interbank-fee law and the competition law.

coverage_gaps.description: European Commission Montenegro country reports (chapters 8 Competition, 28 Consumer and health protection, 4 Free movement of capital) were not fetched, though they audit enforcement performance annually in English.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the annual EC enlargement package Montenegro report to the collection list as an English-language calibration source.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegrin business/investigative media coverage of bank complaints, fee increases and competition cases (Vijesti, Pobjeda, Dan, CIN-CG, Bankar.me) was not scouted in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated media pass with sr terms 'naknade banaka poskupjele', 'pritužbe na banke', 'Agencija za zaštitu konkurencije banka' restricted to those domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Wayback coverage depth for individual ME bank domains (ckb.me, nlb.me, hipotekarnabanka.com, lovcenbanka.me, adriaticbank.com, universalcapitalbank.me, prvabankacg.com) was not enumerated in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the Wayback CDX API per bank domain filtered to PDFs, and count captures per year to identify which banks have gaps needing active Save-Page-Now capture.

coverage_gaps.description: No national digital library / legal-deposit web archive for Montenegro was searched (analogous to national library web archiving programmes elsewhere).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Nacionalna biblioteka Crne Gore Đurđe Crnojević web arhiva / digitalna biblioteka' and check for a legal-deposit web archive covering .me domains.

coverage_gaps.description: EU/ECB-level aggregators (ECB Data Portal, EBA risk dashboards, Eurostat, EBRD/World Bank Global Findex and country diagnostics) were not enumerated for ME banking coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a targeted pass over ECB Data Portal, EBRD and World Bank country datasets to find normalised ME banking/payments series.

coverage_gaps.description: The most authoritative independent commentary (Moody's, S&P, Fitch, Scope, EMIS, Cbonds) is registration- or subscription-gated, so no verified full-text collection method exists without procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide licensing budget; meanwhile rely on free ratings aggregators (countryeconomy, FXEmpire) plus agency press-release headlines for event detection.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegrin sources exist in both Latin and Cyrillic script and under both 'crnogorski' and 'srpski' labelling; only Latin-script sr queries were run this session.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Repeat key queries in Cyrillic ('годишњи извјештај банка Црна Гора') to catch differently-indexed archives.

coverage_gaps.description: CRPI / scmnreporting.me — the presumed official mechanism for storing regulated information — could not be entered in this pass (bare shell, cert-alias mismatch, 404 at reporting-portal root).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser reconnaissance against https://crpi.me/, https://portal.scmnreporting.me/ and https://sp.scmnreporting.me/ to map the public surface; if login-gated, send a written access enquiry to KTK (info@scmn.me, +382 20 442 800) asking whether a public search or bulk export of propisane informacije exists.

coverage_gaps.description: The exchange symbol index reports ~416 symbols but paginates; only the first ~20 were observed. The full set of bank and financial-institution issuers (equity symbols plus bank-issued bonds such as OB17-A, 1PBO1, 1NKBA, INBA) has not been enumerated, and symbol-to-legal-entity mapping is unconfirmed for most.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Paginate /code/navigate.asp?Id=121 fully, join against the KTK issuer register XLS (emitent*.xls) and the CKDD issuer register (/Home/Index/23), and produce a canonical ME listed-financial-issuer table with symbol, stockId, legal name, market segment and instrument type.

coverage_gaps.description: IR/disclosure sections were confirmed in detail only for Hipotekarna banka and CKB (and partially Prva banka). Lovćen banka, NLB Banka Podgorica, Universal Capital Bank, Adriatic Bank, Zapad banka, Erste, Addiko, Ziraat and others were identified as market actors but their listing status and issuer-disclosure pages were not individually verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each entity in the CBCG/KTK bank list, verify (a) whether it has securities admitted to trading on MNSE, and (b) the exact URL of its izvještaji/obavještenja/skupština akcionara section. Prioritise those appearing in the exchange symbol index.

coverage_gaps.description: The seed term 'obavještenje o značajnom događaju' (material-event notice) did not surface a dedicated exchange or regulator section under that exact label. The operative Montenegrin terminology used in practice (e.g. 'propisane informacije', 'unutrašnja informacija', 'informacije koje se objavljuju', 'značajno učešće') has not been pinned to actual publication surfaces.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the exact disclosure-category vocabulary from Zakon o tržištu kapitala (both the older consolidated PDF and the EU-aligned text) and from the MNSE rulebook, then re-run local-language searches on those precise statutory labels to find the matching publication pages.

coverage_gaps.description: No back-series strategy exists for exchange announcements or monthly bulletins; the site offers no visible archive index and news IDs are not densely enumerable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess Wayback Machine coverage of mnse.me/code/navigate.asp?Id=122 and of the older montenegroberza.com content from before the domain was repurposed, to reconstruct pre-2026 issuer announcement history.

coverage_gaps.description: With CKDD shareholder lists request-gated and no visible major-holdings notification feed, threshold-crossing and change-of-control events in listed banks may go undetected between annual reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a composite detector: exchange block-trade symbols (*-B suffixes such as ATBA-B, PREN-B), listing-committee decisions, KTK prospectus publications, and investitor.me/bankar.me coverage — and separately request from KTK whether major-holdings notifications ('značajno učešće') are published anywhere public.

coverage_gaps.description: All observed sources used Latin-script Montenegrin/Serbian; no Cyrillic variants were tested, and diacritic-insensitive matching (Lovcen/Lovćen, izvjestaj/izvještaj, Hipotekarna/HIPOTEKARNA) was not systematically validated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add diacritic-folding and Latin/Cyrillic transliteration normalisation to the entity-matching layer, and run one confirmatory Cyrillic-script search pass over key terms to confirm no separate Cyrillic-only publication channel exists.

coverage_gaps.description: Three registered payment institutions (Prestopay d.o.o., Business Integration and Business Intelligence d.o.o., and to a lesser extent Moneta MNE) have no located web presence; only their CBCG register PDFs describe them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse the individual register PDFs (reg_prestopay.pdf, reg_busin_integr_and_busin_intell.pdf, reg_moneta.pdf) and run CRPS lookups to establish ownership, services and any trading names that would make them findable.

coverage_gaps.description: No interchange-fee / merchant-service-charge disclosure source identified for Montenegro (no equivalent of an EU IFR interchange publication was found).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search CBCG regulation pages and card-scheme (Visa/Mastercard) country interchange documents for Montenegro; also check whether ME acquirers publish MSC ranges in their tariff PDFs on the CBCG tariff pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegrin-Cyrillic and alternative transliteration variants (e.g. 'платна институција', 'електронски новац') were not exercised in this pass; all local-language searching used Latin script.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run key seed queries in Cyrillic and with alias spellings (e-novac, elektronski novac, PSP, PI, IEN) to catch documents indexed only in Cyrillic.

coverage_gaps.description: Public-procurement and tender sources were not scouted, though bank/state tenders for POS, ATM and processing services are a strong indirect reveal of processor market share and contract renewals.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser session against cejn.gov.me/tenders, capture the XHR calls behind the listing, and document the real query endpoint and notice-URL pattern; check whether CEJN exposes an OCDS (Open Contracting Data Standard) feed, which the EU-funded design makes plausible.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an actor map of ME contracting authorities that buy banking/payment services: Ministarstvo finansija / Državni trezor, Uprava prihoda i carina, Uprava za katastar, EPCG, Crnogorski elektroprenosni sistem, Vodovod/Komunalne usluge companies, Fond PIO, Fond zdravstva, Univerzitet CG, and the 25 opštine — then locate each one's 'javne nabavke' page and CEJN buyer id.

Flag 'nabavka', 'usluga' and 'kartice' as high-noise on their own.

coverage_gaps.description: IFI-financed procurement executed by ME clients is split across ECEPP, World Bank STEP/Finances One, and the national portal, with no confirmed way to join records across them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For the TIPS/SEPA and fiscal-stability operations, retrieve the procurement plan and map each planned package to its publication channel, so a single vendor-award timeline can be assembled.

coverage_gaps.description: Card personalisation, card issuing/processing bureaus and switch vendors serving ME (beyond Payten/Bankart) are unmapped — e.g. who processes for Hipotekarna, Prva banka, Universal Capital, Adriatic and Ziraat ME.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a standing crawler over the ~15 identified vendor domains with a Montenegro/ME-bank-name keyword filter, run monthly, diffing new pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegrin-specific orthography and alias variants were only partially exercised (cnr vs sr; 'rješenje' vs 'rešenje'; 'sprječavanje' vs 'sprečavanje'; Latin vs Cyrillic; CKB/Crnogorska komercijalna banka/OTP; NLB Banka Podgorica/NLB Banka Crna Gora/Montenegrobanka).

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-side traces embedded in technical artefacts (mobile app package namespaces, SDK strings, e-banking login page footers, TLS certificate SANs, DNS/MX records of ME bank domains) were identified conceptually but not systematically collected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a deterministic fingerprinting pass over all ME bank web/mobile properties to attribute channel vendors where marketing evidence is absent.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-specific KPIs (card issuing/acquiring volumes, POS/ATM estate, instant payments) inside group reporting were only partially covered - ASEE/Payten found, but card schemes' and processors' group reporting mentioning Montenegro (e.g. Nexi, Worldline, Visa/Mastercard CEE commentary) was not searched.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register the relevant issuer feeds (SEOnet for NLB, BSE for OTP, Vienna/Addiko ad-hoc releases, ESPI for ASEE) to catch Montenegro-relevant ad-hoc announcements (M&A, subsidiary sales) at source.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Back-fill archived annual reports per group (year-foldered PDF paths on nlb.si and otpgroup.info make enumeration feasible) and use Wayback for removed years.

coverage_gaps.description: AmCham Montenegro's exact member-directory and position-paper URLs were not pinned down; the homepage confirms both exist but the site uses two competing path schemes (amcham.me/en/... and www.amcham.me/...) and legacy paths such as /advocacy/ now 404.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search local terms 'udruženje mikrokreditnih finansijskih institucija', 'lizing', 'institucije elektronskog novca', and cross-check against the CBCG register of licensed non-bank financial institutions (handled by the regulator cell) to see whether any trade body exists.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the Glasnik archive page and the ubcg.info publications listing to determine the earliest available issue and whether back issues are paginated or path-enumerable.
